result.note: Tests concrete outcomes of the June 2026 Modi-Macron meeting in Nice: the trade mechanism, security agreements, space and rail intents, and Bharat Innovates.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Emmanuel Macron in Nice in June 2026:
items: It was their first meeting since India and France elevated ties to a Special Global Strategic Partnership.
The leaders agreed to a High-level Mechanism to double bilateral trade within five years.
A General Security Agreement on the exchange and protection of classified information was among the outcomes.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are stated in the story. The meeting produced 13 outcomes spanning defence, critical minerals, space and trade, and the leaders also pushed for early implementation of the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement.
questions.source: The leaders agreed to a High-level Mechanism to double bilateral trade within five years

questions.prompt: Consider the following pairs relating to India-France outcomes announced in Nice in June 2026:
items: ISRO-CNES letter of intent — Human spaceflight
Economic Security Dialogue — Critical minerals supply chains
Declaration of intent — Small modular reactors
questions.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain: The declaration of intent was on high-speed rail in India, so the third pair is wrong. Civil nuclear cooperation, including small and advanced modular reactors, was opened up by India's new SHANTI Act.
questions.source: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and France's Centre National d'Études Spatiales signed a letter of intent on human spaceflight, and the two sides issued a declaration of intent on high-speed rail in India.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Emmanuel Macron jointly inaugurated 'Bharat Innovates' in Nice. What is it?
options: India's first deep-tech showcase held abroad
A joint India-France critical minerals fund
A bilateral human spaceflight training centre
An India-EU free trade implementation body
questions.explain: Bharat Innovates was India's first deep-tech showcase held abroad. It put 120 start-ups in front of more than 350 global investors on the sidelines of the leaders' meeting.
questions.source: On the sidelines, the leaders jointly inaugurated Bharat Innovates, India's first deep-tech showcase held abroad, putting 120 start-ups in front of more than 350 global investors.
